responsibility: Declares the termios wrapper interface for the boot runtime, including the opaque terminal-state type, the control-character and flag enums, and the procedures for querying and setting speeds, flags, control characters, and raw-mode behavior. It is the public contract for host terminal configuration access rather than the implementation of terminal I/O itself.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface definition half of the Gtermios pair: it publishes the opaque termios handle, the Modula-2-facing ControlChar and Flag enums, and the termios_* prototypes, whereas gcc/m2/pge-boot/Gtermios.cc implements the host termios mapping and feature-dependent logic behind them.
